title: OSF UI View Manifest
description: Schema for views/<modId>/<viewName>/manifest.json. Mod API 2.0. Bridge protocol 2.0. Mirrors src/runtime/ViewManifest.cpp. Unknown keys are ALLOWED — the runtime parses leniently, and a manifest written for a newer OSF UI carrying extra fields is the normal compatible case. (`manifestVersion` is one such key: the runtime accepts it, but the nested views/<modId>/<viewName>/ layout is itself the format discriminator, so nothing has to be declared twice and the toolchain does not emit it.) 2.0 changed no manifest FIELD; it changed what several of them mean, because the bridge a manifest opts into is a different one — four verbs, and a page-initiated handshake.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by the runtime.

id.description: The view id. MUST equal the view folder name. The runtime's qualified view id is derived from the path: "<modId>/<viewName>" (e.g. "ozooma10.almanac/planets") - that qualified form is what the menu.open request, RegisterView, and OSFUI.OpenMenu use, and it is what the document is told it is in the `ready` payload's `view`/`mod` fields. Required.

title.description: Human-readable name. Defaults to the qualified id.

description.description: One-line blurb shown in catalogs. Defaults to empty.

accent.description: Optional accent used by platform chrome such as the first-load handoff.

entry.description: Relative path to the entry HTML, inside the view folder. Absolute paths and any '..' component are rejected.

width.description: Initial view width. The d3d12 compositor resizes the view to the screen aspect at runtime; author responsive CSS.

transparent.description: Render with an alpha channel so the game shows through unpainted areas.

kind.description: Surface kind. menu = modal overlay (may capture input, single-menu stack); hud = passive overlay over gameplay (never captures input, pauses, or focuses). Unknown values fall back to menu.

capturesInput.description: Menu-only: while this is the top open menu, freeze the game and route input into the page. Forced false for HUDs.

pausesGame.description: Menu-only: pause the simulation while this is the top open menu. Forced false for HUDs.

openOnStart.description: HUD: the author DEFAULT for automatic start at game launch — the player's per-HUD choice in Mod Settings overrides it. Menu: ignored for discovered views; honored only when a native plugin explicitly calls RegisterView, which is opt-in by the plugin rather than by the mere presence of a folder.

order.description: HUD-only within-band paint order (clamped 0..999): higher draws on top of other HUDs. Ignored for menus.

hub.description: List this view in catalogs (the `osfui/views` state key / the Mods surface). false = hidden utility view; it still loads and works, it just isn't advertised, and it can never be chosen for automatic start. (Field name predates the Mods surface.)

debugOnly.description: When true, this view is kept out of the mod menu list unless the user enables Debug mode (OSF UI → Diagnostics). It still loads and can be opened by id. Intended for built-in developer tools.

readySignal.description: When true, first open waits for the page to call osfui.markReady() (which sends the `view.ready` send endpoint) rather than main-frame load completion. Use it when "loaded" and "has something worth showing" are different moments — a HUD that must fetch state first. Requires permissions.nativeBridge. A 15-second post-load timeout offers retry instead of trapping the player. (2.0 renamed the helper member: `osfui.viewReady()` is gone.)

targetVersion.description: The OSF UI version this view was authored against (e.g. "2.0.0"). Advisory: it never gates loading, and it is not a dependency declaration. A target NEWER than the running host badges 'needs update' on the Mods surface. A target BELOW 2.0 additionally raises a `compat.legacy-view` entry in System Health naming this view, because 2.0 removed every helper member a 1.x view calls (emit, call, action, viewReady, data.*) — such a view loads, throws, and paints nothing, and a legible card beats a blank page. An UNDECLARED targetVersion is deliberately not treated as 1.x: after parsing it is indistinguishable from 'declared and unparsable', and guessing would badge every undeclared view.

permissions.description: Capability grants. Everything defaults to deny.

nativeBridge.description: Inject window.osfui — the four verbs (send / request / on / state) and the page-initiated handshake. If false, no bridge is injected at all and the page runs purely client-side; osfui.available is then false and osfui.request() rejects with "no-bridge" rather than hanging.

filesystem.description: Reserved; no implementation enforces this yet.

network.description: Reserved; forced off with a warning if set true.
